description: This file contains implementation of various numerical linear algebra routines and solvers related to convex optimization, including KKT system solvers, scaling operations, and matrix manipulations, specifically tailored for second-order cone and semidefinite programming problems.

methods.name: kkt_ldl
methods.description: Performs LDL factorization of the KKT matrix for solving linear systems in convex optimization problems.

methods.name: kkt_ldl2
methods.description: Performs LDL factorization of a reduced KKT system for specific problem structures.

methods.name: kkt_chol
methods.description: Performs Cholesky factorization of the KKT matrix for solving linear systems.

methods.name: kkt_chol2
methods.description: Performs Cholesky factorization of the KKT matrix for problems without second-order or semidefinite cones.

methods.name: max_step
methods.description: Computes the maximum step size to maintain feasibility in cone constraints.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Applies Nesterov-Todd scaling or its inverse to vectors/matrices.

methods.name: scale2
methods.description: Evaluates the Hessian of the logarithmic barrier for scaling.

methods.name: compute_scaling
methods.description: Computes the Nesterov-Todd scaling matrix W at given points s and z.

methods.name: update_scaling
methods.description: Updates the scaling matrix W and scaled variable lambda based on current s and z.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Copies vector x into y using packed storage format for the 's' components.

methods.name: pack2
methods.description: In-place version of pack(), for matrix arguments.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Copies from packed storage to unpacked storage, scaling off-diagonal entries.

methods.name: sdot
methods.description: Computes the inner product in the second-order cone space.

methods.name: sdot2
methods.description: Computes inner product of block-diagonal symmetric matrices.

methods.name: snrm2
methods.description: Returns the norm of a vector in the second-order cone.

methods.name: trisc
methods.description: Sets upper triangular part of 's' components to zero and scales lower part.

methods.name: triusc
methods.description: Scales the strictly lower triangular part of 's' components by 0.5.

methods.name: sgemv
methods.description: Performs matrix-vector multiplication with 's' components.

methods.name: jdot
methods.description: Computes x' * J * y, where J = diag(1, -I).

methods.name: jnrm2
methods.description: Computes sqrt(x' * J * x) for a vector in a second order cone.

methods.name: symm
methods.description: Converts lower triangular matrix to symmetric form.

methods.name: sprod
methods.description: Computes the product y o x in the 's' space, with optional diagonal.

methods.name: sinv
methods.description: Computes the inverse product y o	extbackslash x in the 's' space, with diagonal.
